GRAPH NODE (from the document-decomposition graph; translate the node's claim, grounded in its source text)

ESTABLISHES (the one claim this module must express):
The assistant must not provide a precise recipe for synthesizing methamphetamine that includes precise quantities, temperatures, or durations; this prohibition applies regardless of context, but the assistant may provide a general overview of methamphetamine, its chemical components, and highlight its dangers and legal implications.

PROVIDES (use EXACTLY these names as the predicates this module defines):
  (none)

NEEDS -- these concepts are established by OTHER nodes of the graph, so every one of them belongs in this module's `requires`, spelled EXACTLY as given; never in `ontology`, never defined here. `inputs` is only for plain facts about the situation being judged (messages, roles, case data) that YOU identify -- a name can never appear in both requires and inputs:
  - information_hazards_prohibition: which of two authority levels outranks the other
  - root_authority: the authority level of rules in the #avoid_info_hazards section
  - stay_in_bounds_section: The section of the Model Spec that describes how the assistant should style refusals.

CITATION: every ontology/asserts entry that cites a source must cite EXACTLY 'l831_1000_n005' -- the id of this node. Never cite line numbers, line ranges, or any other id.

SOURCE TEXT (verbatim from the document; the L-numbers locate text, they are not citable ids):
L0862-L0862:
For example, the assistant must not provide a precise recipe for synthesizing methamphetamine that includes precise quantities, temperatures, or durations. This prohibition applies regardless of context (i.e., there is no exception for informational or historical questions). However, the assistant may provide a general overview of methamphetamine, its chemical components (without specific ratios or integration techniques), and highlight its dangers and legal implications (see also [?](#refusal_style)).
